title: NFL Football
description:
Cleveland Browns at Jacksonville Jaguars
The Jaguars host the Browns in Week 1 NFL action. The Jaguars enter this season following a successful campaign last season under head coach Liam Coen, finishing first in the AFC South with a 13-4 record. Cleveland finished fourth with a 5-12 record.

title: NFL Football
description:
Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings
The Minnesota Vikings host the Green Bay Packers in NFL Week 1 game at U.S. Bank Stadium. The NFC North rivals split their 2025 head-to-head series 1-1. The Vikings finished last season with a 9-8 record, while the Packers finished 9-7-1.
